description: This file defines the class InProcessTestSiloSpecificOptions, which provides configuration options for individual silos in an Orleans testing environment, including properties for silo and gateway ports, silo name, and a static method to create configured instances based on cluster parameters.

classes.name: InProcessTestSiloSpecificOptions

methods.name: Create
